home.aboutBody: Photographer, videographer and art director, I have worked with brands for ten years in France and internationally. Since 2024, I also train teams to embed AI into their daily production. TROIE brings these two worlds together, creative that gets seen and AI that ships, for demanding brands.
aboutBullets: Studio based in France, missions worldwide
